data.title: 拉姆 · 未收起的薄毯
data.description: 天刚亮，拉姆穿着浴袍坐在床沿，薄毯仍搭在膝上。她伸手推开窗，让凉风进来。
data.promptProse: At first light in her quiet bedroom, Ram sits sideways on the edge of the mattress in her belted ivory bathrobe with a light folded blanket still draped lazily across her knees. Leaning forward slightly, she reaches out to push the wooden casement window ajar so the crisp dawn breeze lifts the sheer curtain inward. Pale early morning light spills across her hands, the bedding, and the open sill.
data.animaCaption: Seated sideways on the bed edge in her ivory bathrobe with a thin blanket draped across her knees, Ram reaches out to push the casement window open. Pale morning light and a cool breeze billow the sheer curtain beside her.
